datasets.name: metric_history
queryLines:
WITH available_contexts AS (
SELECT * FROM monitoring_identities
), chosen_context AS (
 SELECT * FROM available_contexts
 WHERE (COALESCE(:drift_model, '') IN ('', 'All models') OR model_name = :drift_model)
 AND (COALESCE(:drift_version, '') IN ('', 'All versions') OR model_version = :drift_version)
 AND (COALESCE(:drift_monitor, '') IN ('', 'All contexts') OR monitor_context = :drift_monitor)

)
SELECT concat(source.model_name, ' / v', COALESCE(source.model_version, 'unresolved'), ' / ', source.monitor_id) AS model_identity,
 source.* FROM (WITH wide AS (
SELECT monitor_id, report_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, window_start, window_end, measured_at, observed_at, column_name, measurement_status,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('psi', 'psi_categorical') THEN value END) AS psi,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'ks_statistic' THEN value END) AS ks_statistic,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'ks_test_p_value' THEN value END) AS ks_test_p_value,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'wasserstein_distance' THEN value END) AS wasserstein_distance,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'kl_divergence' THEN value END) AS kl_divergence,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'schema_missing' THEN value END) AS schema_missing,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'missing_fraction' THEN value END) AS missing_fraction,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'nonfinite_fraction' THEN value END) AS nonfinite_fraction,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN status = 'unavailable' THEN metric_name END))) AS unavailable_metrics,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN has_issue THEN metric_name END))) AS flagged_metrics
,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('psi', 'psi_categorical') THEN threshold END) AS psi_threshold,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'ks_statistic' THEN threshold END) AS ks_statistic_threshold,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'wasserstein_distance' THEN threshold END) AS wasserstein_distance_threshold,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'kl_divergence' THEN threshold END) AS kl_divergence_threshold,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name IN ('schema_missing', 'type_drift') THEN value END) AS schema_change,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN has_issue AND metric_name <> 'ks_test_p_value' THEN metric_name END))) AS drift_issues
FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'drift'
GROUP BY monitor_id, report_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, window_start, window_end, measured_at, observed_at, column_name, measurement_status
) SELECT *, CASE WHEN psi IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE concat(cast(round(psi, 4) AS STRING), ' / ', cast(psi_threshold AS STRING)) END AS psi_display,
CASE WHEN ks_statistic IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE concat(cast(round(ks_statistic, 4) AS STRING), ' / ', cast(ks_statistic_threshold AS STRING)) END AS ks_statistic_display,
CASE WHEN wasserstein_distance IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE concat(cast(round(wasserstein_distance, 4) AS STRING), ' / ', cast(wasserstein_distance_threshold AS STRING)) END AS wasserstein_distance_display,
CASE WHEN kl_divergence IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE concat(cast(round(kl_divergence, 4) AS STRING), ' / ', cast(kl_divergence_threshold AS STRING)) END AS kl_divergence_display,
CASE WHEN drift_issues <> '' THEN 'Drift detected' WHEN unavailable_metrics <> '' THEN 'Some checks unavailable' ELSE 'No drift detected' END AS drift_status FROM wide ORDER BY measured_at DESC, model_name, column_name, report_id) source JOIN chosen_context context
 ON source.monitor_id = context.monitor_id AND source.model_name = context.model_name
 AND source.model_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM context.model_version

MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_ovr' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_ovr,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_ovo' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_ovo,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_ovr_weighted' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_ovr_weighted,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_ovo_weighted' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_ovo_weighted,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'roc_auc_weighted' THEN value END) AS roc_auc_weighted,
MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'pr_auc_weighted' THEN value END) AS pr_auc_weighted,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN status = 'unavailable' THEN metric_name END))) AS unavailable_metrics,
concat_ws(', ', sort_array(collect_set(CASE WHEN has_issue THEN metric_name END))) AS flagged_metrics
FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'performance'
GROUP BY monitor_id, report_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, window_start, window_end, measured_at, observed_at, column_name, measurement_status
) SELECT w.*, r.scored_rows, r.labeled_rows, CASE WHEN r.status = 'failed' THEN 'Measurement failed'
 WHEN r.scored_rows IS NULL OR r.scored_rows = 0 THEN 'No predictions to evaluate'
 WHEN r.labeled_rows = 0 THEN concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; waiting for actual target values')
 WHEN r.labeled_rows < 2 THEN concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; only 1 actual target matched; at least 2 are required for performance')
 ELSE concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; ', cast(r.labeled_rows AS STRING), ' matched actual targets; performance calculated from these ', cast(r.labeled_rows AS STRING), ' records') END AS outcome_summary FROM wide w JOIN monitoring_results r ON w.report_id = r.report_id ORDER BY w.measured_at DESC, w.model_name, w.report_id) source JOIN chosen_context context
 ON source.monitor_id = context.monitor_id AND source.model_name = context.model_name

datasets.name: performance_cells
queryLines:
WITH available_contexts AS (

 source.* FROM (WITH observations AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT report_id, monitor_id, model_name, model_version, column_name, measured_at
 FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'performance'
), numbered AS (
 SELECT *, count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY model_name, model_version, column_name, measured_at) AS same_time,
 row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY model_name, model_version, column_name, measured_at ORDER BY monitor_id, report_id) AS sequence
 FROM observations
)
SELECT m.report_id, m.monitor_id, m.model_catalog, m.model_schema, m.model_name, m.model_version,
 m.column_name, m.window_start, m.window_end, m.measured_at, m.observed_at, m.metric_name, m.value,
 concat(date_format(m.measured_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSSSSS'),
   CASE WHEN n.same_time > 1 THEN concat(' #', cast(n.sequence AS STRING)) ELSE '' END) AS observation,
 CASE WHEN r.status = 'failed' THEN 'Measurement failed'
 WHEN r.scored_rows IS NULL OR r.scored_rows = 0 THEN 'No predictions to evaluate'
 WHEN r.labeled_rows = 0 THEN concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; waiting for actual target values')
 WHEN r.labeled_rows < 2 THEN concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; only 1 actual target matched; at least 2 are required for performance')
 ELSE concat(cast(r.scored_rows AS STRING), ' predictions; ', cast(r.labeled_rows AS STRING), ' matched actual targets; performance calculated from these ', cast(r.labeled_rows AS STRING), ' records') END AS outcome_summary
FROM metric_history m JOIN numbered n ON m.report_id = n.report_id AND m.column_name = n.column_name
JOIN monitoring_results r ON m.report_id = r.report_id
WHERE m.category = 'performance'
ORDER BY m.measured_at DESC, m.model_name, m.metric_name) source JOIN chosen_context context
 ON source.monitor_id = context.monitor_id AND source.model_name = context.model_name
 AND source.model_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM context.model_version

datasets.name: performance_chart
queryLines:
WITH available_contexts AS (
SELECT * FROM monitoring_identities
), chosen_context AS (
 SELECT * FROM available_contexts
 WHERE (COALESCE(:trend_model, '') IN ('', 'All models') OR model_name = :trend_model)
 AND (COALESCE(:trend_version, '') IN ('', 'All versions') OR model_version = :trend_version)
 AND (COALESCE(:trend_monitor, '') IN ('', 'All contexts') OR monitor_context = :trend_monitor)

), available_metrics AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT source.monitor_id, source.model_name, source.model_version, metric_name
 FROM metric_history source JOIN chosen_context context
 ON source.monitor_id = context.monitor_id AND source.model_name = context.model_name
 AND source.model_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM context.model_version
 WHERE category = 'performance'
 AND (COALESCE(:performance_metric, '') = '' OR metric_name = :performance_metric)
), selected_metric AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY monitor_id, model_name, model_version
 ORDER BY CASE metric_name WHEN 'mae' THEN 0 WHEN 'f1_weighted' THEN 1
 WHEN 'accuracy' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, metric_name) AS metric_rank
 FROM available_metrics
)
SELECT concat(concat(source.model_name, ' / v', COALESCE(source.model_version, 'unresolved'), ' / ', source.monitor_id), ' / ', upper(source.metric_name)) AS model_panel,
 source.report_id, source.monitor_id, source.model_catalog, source.model_schema,
 source.model_name, source.model_version, source.window_start, source.window_end, source.measured_at, source.observed_at,
 source.column_name, source.metric_name, source.value,
 concat(upper(source.metric_name), CASE WHEN source.metric_name IN ('mae','mse','rmse','mape','log_loss')
 THEN ' - lower is better' ELSE ' - higher is better' END, ' / ', column_name) AS metric_label
FROM metric_history source JOIN chosen_context context
 ON source.monitor_id = context.monitor_id AND source.model_name = context.model_name
 AND source.model_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM context.model_version
JOIN selected_metric selected ON source.monitor_id = selected.monitor_id
 AND source.model_name = selected.model_name AND source.model_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM selected.model_version
 AND source.metric_name = selected.metric_name AND selected.metric_rank = 1
WHERE category = 'performance'
ORDER BY measured_at, report_id

queryLines:

), latest_reports AS (SELECT report_id, row_number() OVER (
 PARTITION BY monitor_id, model_name, model_version
 ORDER BY window_end DESC, measured_at DESC, report_id DESC) AS report_rank
 FROM complete_observations), ranked AS (
 SELECT selected.*, latest_reports.report_rank FROM selected JOIN latest_reports
 ON selected.report_id = latest_reports.report_id
), feature_ranked AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY monitor_id, model_name, model_version
 ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST, column_name) AS feature_rank
 FROM ranked WHERE report_rank = 1 AND metric_name IN ('psi', 'psi_categorical')
), top_features AS (SELECT * FROM feature_ranked WHERE feature_rank <= 10)
SELECT concat(model_name, ' / v', COALESCE(model_version, 'unresolved'), ' / ', monitor_id) AS model_panel,
 report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 window_start, window_end, measured_at, observed_at, measurement_status, column_name, value AS plot_value,
 'Measured PSI' AS series FROM top_features
UNION ALL

 report_id, monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version,
 window_start, window_end, measured_at, observed_at, measurement_status, column_name, threshold AS plot_value,
 'PSI limit' AS series FROM top_features
ORDER BY column_name, series

datasets.name: performance_policy
queryLines:
WITH available_contexts AS (
SELECT * FROM monitoring_identities
), chosen_context AS (
 SELECT * FROM available_contexts
 WHERE (COALESCE(:trend_model, '') IN ('', 'All models') OR model_name = :trend_model)
 AND (COALESCE(:trend_version, '') IN ('', 'All versions') OR model_version = :trend_version)
 AND (COALESCE(:trend_monitor, '') IN ('', 'All contexts') OR monitor_context = :trend_monitor)

)
SELECT concat(source.model_name, ' / v', COALESCE(source.model_version, 'unresolved'), ' / ', source.monitor_id) AS model_identity,
 source.*,
 CASE WHEN source.status IN ('disabled', 'off', 'policy_off') THEN 'Policy disabled'
 WHEN source.status = 'degraded' THEN 'Performance loss'
 WHEN source.status = 'healthy' THEN 'Within tolerance'
 ELSE 'Insufficient evidence' END AS result_label,
 CASE WHEN source.action = 'none' THEN 'No training requested'
 WHEN source.action = 'report' THEN 'Report only'
 WHEN source.action = 'request_eligible' THEN 'Eligible; checks pending'
 WHEN source.action = 'retraining_requested' THEN 'Training requested'
 WHEN source.action = 'retraining_skipped' THEN 'Training skipped'
 ELSE 'Not evaluated' END AS action_label
FROM (SELECT report_id, monitor_id, environment, project, model_name, model_version, model_catalog, model_schema, measured_at, observed_at, window_start, window_end, status, reason, metric, direction, baseline_kind, baseline_reference, baseline_value, current_value, absolute_degradation, relative_degradation, tolerance, tolerance_mode, threshold_value, labeled_rows, label_coverage, consecutive_failures, required_windows, action, action_reason, request_id, run_id, metric AS metric_name FROM performance_history) source JOIN chosen_context context
 ON source.monitor_id = context.monitor_id AND source.model_name = context.model_name
 AND source.model_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM context.model_version
ORDER BY window_end DESC, measured_at DESC, report_id DESC

 AND abs(latest_policy.baseline_value - latest_policy.threshold_value) > 0
 THEN CASE WHEN latest_policy.direction = 'higher' THEN latest_policy.current_value - latest_policy.threshold_value

 / abs(latest_policy.baseline_value - latest_policy.threshold_value) END AS limit_margin,
 CASE WHEN report_id IS NULL THEN 'No policy evidence'
 WHEN status IN ('disabled', 'off', 'policy_off') THEN 'Policy disabled'

queryLines:
SELECT * FROM (
WITH inventory AS (
 SELECT i.monitor_id, i.model_catalog, i.model_schema, i.model_name,
 COALESCE(get_json_object(i.config_json, '$.model_version'), h.model_version) AS model_version,
 i.enabled, i.config_digest, i.expected_interval_hours,
 concat(i.environment, ' / ', i.project, ' / ', substring(i.monitor_id, 1, 12)) AS monitor_context,
 COALESCE(get_json_object(i.config_json, '$.performance_policy.mode'), 'off') AS policy_mode,
 CAST(get_json_object(i.config_json, '$.performance_policy.window_hours') AS DOUBLE) * 3600 AS window_seconds,
 CAST(get_json_object(i.config_json, '$.performance_policy.label_delay_hours') AS DOUBLE) * 3600 AS delay_seconds
 FROM model_inventory i LEFT JOIN current_health h ON i.monitor_id = h.monitor_id
), ranked AS (
 SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
 PARTITION BY p.monitor_id, p.config_digest, p.model_version
 ORDER BY window_end DESC, measured_at DESC, report_id DESC
 ) AS report_rank
 FROM performance_history p JOIN inventory i
 ON p.monitor_id = i.monitor_id AND p.config_digest = i.config_digest
 AND p.model_version = i.model_version
), evidence AS (
 SELECT i.*, p.report_id, p.window_end, p.measured_at,
 p.status AS saved_status, p.reason AS saved_reason,
 FLOOR((unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) - i.delay_seconds)
 / NULLIF(i.window_seconds, 0)) * i.window_seconds AS mature_window_end,
 unix_timestamp(current_timestamp()) AS now_seconds
 FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN ranked p ON i.monitor_id = p.monitor_id AND p.report_rank = 1
), checked AS (
 SELECT *, CASE
 WHEN NOT enabled THEN 'monitoring_disabled'
 WHEN policy_mode = 'off' THEN 'policy_off'
 WHEN model_version IS NULL THEN 'unresolved_model_version'
 WHEN report_id IS NULL THEN 'no_matching_report'
 WHEN window_end IS NULL THEN 'missing_performance_window'
 WHEN measured_at IS NULL THEN 'missing_measurement_time'
 WHEN unix_timestamp(measured_at) > now_seconds THEN 'future_measurement'
 WHEN mature_window_end IS NULL THEN 'missing_policy_window_configuration'
 WHEN unix_timestamp(window_end) > mature_window_end THEN 'performance_window_not_mature'
 WHEN mature_window_end - unix_timestamp(window_end) > expected_interval_hours * 3600
 THEN 'stale_performance_window'
 ELSE NULL END AS evidence_issue
 FROM evidence
), classified AS (
 SELECT *, CASE
 WHEN NOT enabled THEN 'Monitoring disabled'
 WHEN policy_mode = 'off' THEN 'Policy disabled'
 WHEN evidence_issue IS NOT NULL THEN 'Insufficient evidence'
 WHEN saved_status = 'healthy' THEN 'Within tolerance'
 WHEN saved_status = 'degraded' THEN 'Performance loss'
 ELSE 'Insufficient evidence' END AS performance_status,
 COALESCE(evidence_issue, saved_reason, 'missing_policy_evidence') AS performance_reason
 FROM checked
)
SELECT monitor_id, model_catalog, model_schema, model_name, model_version, monitor_context,
 performance_status, performance_reason, report_id, window_end, measured_at, saved_status,
 CASE WHEN performance_status = 'Within tolerance' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS within_tolerance_count,
 CASE WHEN performance_status = 'Performance loss' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS performance_loss_count,
 CASE WHEN performance_status = 'Insufficient evidence' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS insufficient_evidence_count,
 CASE WHEN performance_status = 'Policy disabled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS policy_disabled_count
FROM classified ORDER BY model_name, model_version, monitor_id
) portfolio
WHERE (COALESCE(:scope_model, '') IN ('', 'All models') OR model_name = :scope_model)
 AND (COALESCE(:scope_version, '') IN ('', 'All versions') OR model_version = :scope_version)
 AND (COALESCE(:scope_monitor, '') IN ('', 'All contexts') OR monitor_context = :scope_monitor)

 MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'measured' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS all_measured,

 FROM metric_history WHERE category = 'drift' AND metric_name <> 'ks_test_p_value'
 GROUP BY report_id
), daily AS (

 ELSE COALESCE(c.any_measured, 0) END AS any_measured,
 CASE WHEN r.status IN ('failed', 'no_data') THEN 0
 ELSE COALESCE(c.all_measured, 0) END AS all_measured,
 CASE WHEN r.status IN ('failed', 'no_data') THEN 0
 ELSE COALESCE(c.has_drift, 0) END AS has_drift
 FROM ranked r LEFT JOIN checks c ON r.report_id = c.report_id
 WHERE r.report_rank = 1
)

 FROM complete_observations source JOIN chosen_context context ON source.monitor_id = context.monitor_id AND source.model_name = context.model_name
 AND source.model_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM context.model_version
), selected AS (

 AND history.model_name = reports.model_name
 AND history.model_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM reports.model_version
 WHERE reports.report_rank <= 12 AND history.category = 'quality'
 AND history.metric_name = 'missing_fraction'
), feature_scores AS (
 SELECT monitor_id, model_name, model_version, column_name, MAX(missing_fraction) AS maximum_ratio
 FROM selected GROUP BY monitor_id, model_name, model_version, column_name
), features AS (
 SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY monitor_id, model_name, model_version
 ORDER BY maximum_ratio DESC NULLS LAST, column_name) AS feature_rank FROM feature_scores
)
SELECT concat(s.model_name, ' / v', COALESCE(s.model_version, 'unresolved'), ' / ', s.monitor_id) AS model_identity,

 concat(date_format(s.window_end, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' #', CAST(s.report_count - s.report_rank + 1 AS STRING)) AS observation_label
FROM selected s JOIN features f ON s.monitor_id = f.monitor_id AND s.model_name = f.model_name
 AND s.model_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM f.model_version AND s.column_name = f.column_name

 CASE WHEN source.status = 'failed' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(get_json_object(source.report_json, '$.current_rows') AS BIGINT) END AS current_rows,

 CASE WHEN source.status = 'failed' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(get_json_object(source.report_json, '$.labeled_rows') AS BIGINT) END AS labeled_rows,

)

UNION ALL

queryLines:
WITH history AS (
SELECT monitor_id, model_name, model_version, monitor_context, endpoint, served_model, served_version, served_branch, report_id, window_start, window_end, measured_at, status, request_count, success_count, error_count, logging_error_count, status_4xx_count, status_5xx_count, status_other_count, latency_sample_count, latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms, latency_bucket_edges_ms, latency_bucket_counts, latency_mean_ms, latency_max_ms, prediction_row_count, classes_complete, concat(model_name, ' / v', COALESCE(model_version, 'unresolved'), ' / ', monitor_id) AS model_identity, error_rate, rows_per_request, plot_4xx, plot_5xx, plot_other, concat(date_format(window_end, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), ' / ', CAST(observation_sequence AS STRING)) AS observation_label, observation_recency, COALESCE(CAST(logging_error_count AS STRING), 'Not recorded') AS logging_errors_display, COALESCE(CAST(latency_p50_ms AS STRING), 'Not recorded') AS latency_p50_display, COALESCE(CAST(latency_p95_ms AS STRING), 'Not recorded') AS latency_p95_display, COALESCE(CAST(latency_p99_ms AS STRING), 'Not recorded') AS latency_p99_display, COALESCE(CAST(latency_sample_count AS STRING), 'Not recorded') AS latency_samples_display
FROM serving_windows
WHERE (COALESCE(:serving_model, '') IN ('', 'All models') OR model_name = :serving_model)
 AND (COALESCE(:serving_version, '') IN ('', 'All versions') OR model_version = :serving_version)
 AND (COALESCE(:serving_monitor, '') IN ('', 'All contexts') OR monitor_context = :serving_monitor)
ORDER BY window_end DESC, measured_at DESC, report_id DESC
), ranked AS (
 SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY monitor_id, model_version ORDER BY window_end DESC, measured_at DESC, report_id DESC) AS observation_rank,
 from_json(latency_bucket_counts, 'ARRAY<BIGINT>') AS bin_counts,
 from_json(latency_bucket_edges_ms, 'ARRAY<BIGINT>') AS bin_edges
 FROM history
), valid AS (
 SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE observation_rank <= 12 AND status <> 'failed'
 AND request_count > 0 AND latency_sample_count > 0 AND latency_sample_count <= request_count
 AND bin_edges = array(5L, 10L, 25L, 50L, 100L, 250L, 500L, 1000L)
 AND size(bin_counts) = 9 AND forall(bin_counts, n -> n IS NOT NULL AND n >= 0)
 AND aggregate(bin_counts, CAST(0 AS BIGINT), (a, n) -> a + n) = latency_sample_count
)
SELECT model_name, model_version, monitor_id, monitor_context, model_identity, endpoint,
 report_id, window_start, window_end, measured_at, observation_label, latency_sample_count,
 bucket_index, bucket_count, bucket_count * 1.0 / latency_sample_count AS latency_fraction,
 element_at(array('1: <5 ms', '2: 5-<10 ms', '3: 10-<25 ms', '4: 25-<50 ms', '5: 50-<100 ms',
 '6: 100-<250 ms', '7: 250-<500 ms', '8: 500-<1000 ms', '9: >=1000 ms'), bucket_index + 1) AS latency_range
FROM valid LATERAL VIEW posexplode(bin_counts) bins AS bucket_index, bucket_count
ORDER BY model_identity, window_end, measured_at, report_id, bucket_index

lines: ## Model monitoring

Portfolio scope: All models / All versions / All contexts show every registered model; choose Model, Monitored version or Context to narrow all widgets. Counts are monitoring registrations, not unique models, except Registered models.

frame.title: Monitoring registrations
frame.description: Per environment / project / model

lines: ## Issues to investigate

Failures first, then recorded threshold issues, then missing or stale evidence. The count includes all filtered rows; use native table pagination. Disabled monitoring and policies create no new failure. Evidence run opens monitoring evidence; Training and lineage opens the owning training run.

frame.title: Feature and data health - current contexts

lines: Daily history: each context contributes at most one observation per day. These trends are separate from current status above. Missing evidence is not a healthy result; disabled policy is not performance loss.

frame.title: Daily drift checks
frame.description: Registrations with drift, any measured check, or unavailable checks; categories can overlap.

frame.title: Daily performance checks
frame.description: Measured includes within tolerance and loss; insufficient evidence is separate.

frame.title: Models and their tables
frame.description: Current enrollment configuration. Scoring inputs are the tables used for prediction; actual targets are optional.

lines: ## Training and lineage

Compare registered versions and their owning training runs. All models / All versions / All contexts show all models; Model, Monitored version and Context narrow every table on this page. A mismatched selection stays empty.

frame.title: Concrete version and owning training run

lines:
### Saved training evidence

Recorded rows show evidence saved for this model/version/context. not_recorded means no saved evidence; unavailable, invalid or too_large explain an incomplete capture; never_observed means no monitoring observation exists. Candidate run wall seconds include the full run lifecycle. CV scores are not necessarily unbiased; inspect Evaluation mode and Unbiased estimate. Hover over candidate, dataset, source table and role cells for provenance details. Dataset Inputs run opens the verified owning run; select Inputs there.

Delta table ID: {{delta_table_id}}
Unity Catalog table ID: {{uc_table_id}}

Experiment: {{experiment_id}}
Open the run and select Inputs when the link is available.

lines: Aliases at capture is a recorded registry snapshot, not historical deployment identity or a guarantee of today's aliases. New observations refresh the bounded snapshot; dashboard refresh only rereads saved evidence. Exact retries retain the first saved snapshot. Missing metadata and links stay unavailable. Open the owning Training run for native Inputs and artifacts.
## Drift and data quality
All includes every matching model, version and monitoring context. Each chart panel and table row keeps that identity separate. Shared Model, Version and Context filters narrow the portfolio.

Each identity has its own latest top ten PSI values and limits, and its own drift-count history. Time means the end of the data window: a 09:00-10:00 window is plotted at 10:00, even if calculated later. Counts from overlapping windows are not added together.

frame.title: Which features changed?
frame.description: Latest observation per model/version/context. Top ten PSI values and their own limits. Scroll for more panels; select Context to show one.

frame.title: How many features show drift?
frame.description: Whole-number counts per model/version/context and data window. Red: drift. Gray: unavailable checks. Scroll for more panels; select Context to show one.

lines: Each metric has its own limit. A value above its limit indicates drift. KS p-value is diagnostic only; the KS statistic determines drift.

frame.title: When did each feature start missing values?
frame.description: Latest 12 observations and top 10 features per identity. The shared color scale is 0-100% missing; use tooltips for small rates. Reference rate is a baseline, not an alert limit. Nonfinite rates remain in the quality table.

frame.title: When did each feature drift?
frame.description: Latest 12 observations and top 10 features per identity. Red: PSI exceeds its own limit. Gray: at or below the limit. Empty: no valid measurement or positive limit. Hover for PSI, limit, ratio and full UTC times. Panel numbers distinguish identities in the current selection.

lines:
## Model performance
All shows every matching model, version and context. Policy results and charts retain each model's own metric. Use the shared filters to focus on one model; date and target filters refine history without replacing latest evidence.

frame.title: Latest prediction coverage by model
frame.description: One latest full observation per identity. Overlapping windows and contexts are not added together.

frame.title: Latest observed metric by model
frame.description: The latest full observation of each identity. Missing latest results never fall back to older values.

frame.title: Observed performance over time
frame.description: Saved scores by model/version/context/metric. No Chart metric: each identity's default. Missing scores have no point. Scroll for more panels; select Context to narrow.

lines:
### Performance against each model's reference
Accuracy, F1 and error metrics use different policies. Each panel shows one identity and its configured metric, baseline and limit. Falling below a score limit or rising above an error limit indicates degradation; training also requires an enabled policy and eligible data.

frame.title: Latest policy result for every model
frame.description: Each identity uses its own policy metric, baseline and allowed limit. Disabled and unmeasured policies remain visible.

frame.title: Is performance within its allowed limit?
frame.description: Current, Baseline and Tolerance boundary per model/version/context/metric. Independent of Chart metric; missing scores have no point. Scroll for more panels.

frame.title: Performance checks
frame.description: Each completed window is compared with its baseline. Performance loss does not by itself mean training started.

lines: ### Classification results

frame.title: Confusion matrix
frame.description: Each model/version/context has separate actual-class rows. Counts from different identities are never combined.

frame.title: Classification evidence
frame.description: Regression has no confusion matrix. Missing results are not zero counts.

lines: ### Metric history

Chart times and date filters use the data window end (UTC). Calculation time is shown separately. Summary and classification tables keep the latest full observation per identity, including failed or unavailable results; history filters do not substitute older evidence. Missing outcomes are not zeros.

frame.title: How much data was scored and labeled?
frame.description: Each bar is one full observation. The blue share is label coverage. Bars are not additive across observations. Gray means coverage was not measured; missing counts leave gaps.

frame.title: Which model is closest to its policy limit?
frame.description: One bar per identity from its latest saved policy window. Zero is the limit; negative is beyond it. Color follows the saved verdict. Policies without usable tolerance remain in the table only.

lines: ## Online serving

All matching endpoints are listed separately; choose Model, Version and Context to narrow the scope. Version refers to the monitored model, not its served parent. Captured logs arrive asynchronously and may omit HTTP failures. Counts are not all endpoint traffic. Observation status is not endpoint availability. Overlapping windows and model-set branches must not be summed.

frame.title: Latest observation per context
frame.description: One row per enrolled monitor; a failed latest observation clears earlier counts. Requests with logging errors remain in counts; their payloads are excluded from drift and performance.

frame.title: History window end (UTC); latest snapshot stays unchanged
Observation history - windows may overlap
frame.description: All matching saved observations with native pagination; history date selection leaves the latest snapshot unchanged. Requests with logging errors remain in counts; their payloads are excluded from drift and performance.

frame.title: Captured requests per window
frame.description: Requests in each time window. Each context is separate; repeated or overlapping windows must not be added together. Requests with logging errors remain in counts; their payloads are excluded from drift and performance.

frame.title: How many errors of each kind?
frame.description: Blue: 4xx client errors. Red: 5xx server errors. Gray: other codes or older totals without a recorded class. Each observation has separate bars; 0 means none captured, blank means class not recorded. Repeated windows are separate calculations. Platform logging can omit error responses.

frame.title: How long does the model take to answer?
frame.description: Latest 12 monitoring observations per model/version/context. Each group is one observation. Blue is the average execution time per request; orange is the approximate time 95% of timed requests stayed under. Model computation only, not network time. Missing measurements have no bar; the observation tables show Not recorded. They are not zero. Repeated windows are separate calculations.

frame.title: Captured error rate per window
frame.description: Errors divided by captured requests in the same window. Zero requests or missing evidence leave gaps. Scroll for other identities.

frame.title: Where do captured execution times fall?
frame.description: Latest 12 observations per model/version/context. Each column totals 100% of non-null timings, including failed responses. Old, failed, empty or invalid summaries leave no cells. Color scale: 0-100%.
